description: A convoy commander must approve the loading plan for three support modules on one heavy trailer, including each module's position, handling method, loading time, and required checks before dispatch.

shared_context.S1: One heavy trailer is available for the communications shelter, water tank module, and generator module scheduled for delivery to the forward support area.
shared_context.S2: The trailer has three designated positions: front, center, and rear, and the convoy departs at 1600 tomorrow.
shared_context.S3: The standard movement-control procedure requires a written load plan and completion of all applicable pre-dispatch safety checks before the trailer is released.
shared_context.S4: Capt. Morgan holds the routine pre-movement load-planning review with the loadmaster, route liaison, and maintenance chief, and each staff member reports any update from their lane before the board is approved.
shared_context.S5: The draft manifest lists the communications shelter, water tank module, and generator module, but does not assign trailer positions pending the final load-planning review.
shared_context.S6: Under the movement-control procedure, each lane owner must enter a changed measurement, placement requirement, or maintenance status as a formal fact-update entry on the movement board during the review; a verbal mention alone does not update the board, and Capt. Morgan verifies those entries before approval.

PF1.text: Sgt. Patel reweighed the communications shelter this morning and confirmed it is 8,400 pounds rather than the 6,000 pounds shown on the draft manifest; placing it in the center position is required for axle balance, and an axle-balance check must be completed before release. The corrected scale ticket has not yet been attached to the movement packet.

PF2.text: Lt. Alvarez confirmed with the receiving site that the water tank's vent cap raises its loaded height to 13 feet, while the approved access structure allows only 12 feet 6 inches. The vent cap must be removed and secured before movement, the water tank must use the front position so the rear approach remains clear for the generator's loading equipment, and a pre-dispatch height check must be completed. This confirmation has not yet been added to the load-planning slide.

PF3.text: SFC Brooks found during this morning's inspection that the generator module's lifting eye is not serviceable, so it must be loaded with the side-forklift rather than the trailer crane. The rear position is required for the side-forklift approach, and the only qualified forklift crew is booked at 1400 tomorrow; the maintenance note has not yet been posted to the movement board.

acceptance_conditions: The communications shelter must be placed in the center position because its confirmed weight is 8,400 pounds.
The water tank must be placed in the front position, and its vent cap must be removed and secured before movement.
The generator must be placed in the rear position and loaded with the side-forklift.
The generator must be scheduled for loading at 1400 tomorrow.
Both the pre-dispatch height check and axle-balance check must be retained in the plan.
The plan must include a vent-cap control commitment and a forklift-coordination commitment.
The corrected communications-shelter weight must be cited as a justification.

content_checks.C8: any('Lt. Alvarez' in c['target'] and 'vent cap' in c['detail'] and ('remov' in c['detail'] or 'secur' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('SFC Brooks' in c['target'] and 'forklift' in c['detail'] and 'crew' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The corrected 8,400-pound weight changes the communications shelter's placement to center and requires the axle-balance check, while supplying the specific fact that must be cited.

The 13-foot vented height and receiving-site placement note require the water tank to use the front position, require the vent cap to be secured, and require the pre-dispatch height check and vent-cap control commitment.

The failed lifting eye and rear-position requirement change the generator's placement to rear, require side-forklift handling, and require scheduling the qualified forklift crew at exactly 1400 tomorrow with a coordination commitment.
